name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Cleans up after itself in two places that previously left dead items behind. (1) Uninstalling the plugin from the dashboard now removes every federated Movie/Series/Season/Episode item it ever created, across every mapped library, before the plugin is unloaded - previously these virtual items (which have no real file behind them) were left in the library forever, since nothing would ever provide a MediaSource for them again or clean them up once the plugin providing that sync was gone. Implemented via BasePlugin.OnUninstalling(), which Jellyfin's plugin manager calls before removing the plugin's own DLL/data folder - that removal step was already handled correctly by Jellyfin core and is unaffected by this change. (2) Confirmed removing a remote server ("Servers/{id}" DELETE) already reconciles every affected library inline and removes its items immediately rather than waiting for the next sync - this was already correct, verified while implementing (1).
